name: Kids Summer Learning Center (KSLC)
description_short: One-week summer enrichment classes held at Somerset Berkley Regional High School and taught by area teachers. Subjects include STEM, music, art, writing, cooking and flag football, and children can sign up for one week or several.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2024 season ('Classes for Summer 2024', 'Register now for summer 2024!'). It is now October 2026, so the classes, dates and availability may not be current for 2026 or 2027.

The only date on the page is the Flag Football class in the week of July 22 (2024), for grades 4 through 8. The page does not give dates for any other class.
